overview: The City Council ordained major zoning amendments for the Boston Avenue corridor and approved a new Public Tree Ordinance. The Council also voted to support legal intervention in a federal lawsuit involving the city's values-based investment ordinance.

items.title: Resolutions and Records
items.summary: Approved a resolution inviting residents to a Ward 1 neighborhood meeting, recognized National Recovery Month, honored the memory of Lorraine Marie Miles, and approved committee reports and records.

items.title: West Medford Train Station Safety
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Public Health and Community Safety Committee to discuss a timeline for safety upgrades with the MBTA following a fatal accident at the West Medford station.

items.title: Common Victualler's Licenses
items.summary: Approved common victualler's licenses for Ebisuya, Moussey and Co., and Rosso's Grill.

items.title: CPA Appropriation: Trees Medford
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $8,500 from the CPA Open Space Reserve for the Berry Park College Avenue Plantings Project led by Trees Medford.

items.title: Release of Vijay D'Souza
items.summary: Approved a resolution calling for the immediate release of Medford resident Vijay D'Souza from ICE detention and condemning his abduction in Atlanta.

items.title: Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District Zoning
items.summary: Ordained the new zoning district after reconsidering a previous vote, ultimately approving a 10-foot step back at North Street and making purpose-built student housing a use allowed by right in the BA3 sub-district.

items.title: Declaration on Chertok v. City of Medford
items.summary: Approved a declaration supporting intervention by residents or the Attorney General in federal litigation regarding the city's investment ordinance to ensure the law is effectively defended.

items.title: Public Tree Ordinance
items.summary: Ordained the Public Tree Ordinance to establish long-term management and preservation standards for trees on public land.

items.title: Police Chief Hiring Committee
items.summary: Appointed Vice President Lazzaro to represent the Council on the interview panel for the new police chief and requested a public meeting with the search consultants.

items.title: Building Height Definition
items.summary: Confirmed that a standardized definition for measuring building height from finished grade was formally adopted citywide as part of the Medford Square zoning amendments.

items.title: Fines, Private Ways, and Settlement
items.summary: Referred municipal fine enforcement and private way maintenance issues to committees for further review and approved an $11,640 litigation settlement for building damage.

items.title: Board Appointments and Legal Funding
items.summary: Tabled discussions on Law Department appropriations while approving several new appointments and reappointments to city boards and commissions.
